# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Runtime performance and reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves managed rendering and text-shaping performance while correcting stream lifetime behavior. Image pixel copies and HarfBuzz text encoding allocate less during repeated use, while native feature-string decoding avoids an unnecessary allocation.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed image and text shaping allocations reduced** — Image pixel copies are optimized, and HarfBuzzSharp reuses its UTF-32 encoding buffer to reduce allocation pressure in repeated rendering and shaping workloads. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060))
- **Feature-string decoding avoids native allocation** — Parsing OpenType feature strings no longer allocates native memory unnecessarily while preserving the existing decoded results. ([#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered streams release retained data** — Corrects front-buffered stream retention so buffered data is not kept alive longer than intended. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
